usafacts_voter_registration.name: USAFacts Voter Registration by Party Affiliation
usafacts_voter_registration.description: USAFacts compiled county voter registration by party affiliation from official state sources, typically the secretary of state's website, for the 27 states and Washington, DC, that record party affiliation and publish it at the county level. Because states publish registration reports at different frequencies, USAFacts selected the report closest to November of each year; the most recent data point is generally from early 2026. Most states span 2016 to 2026, but some start later (Kentucky in 2017, Idaho and Rhode Island in 2018) or end earlier (California, Connecticut, and Massachusetts in 2025), and some states did not publish data for every year. In states that distinguish between active and inactive registrations, only active voters are counted. Connecticut is reported for its eight former counties.
